shortdesc.ph: Sets the allowlist for video stream subscription.
Sets the video stream subscription allowlist.
Sets the allowlist of subscriptions for video streams.

p.codeblock: virtual int setSubscribeVideoAllowlist(uid_t* uidList, int uidNumber) = 0;

ul.li: You can call this method before or after joining a channel.
The allowlist is not affected by , , or the autoSubscribeAudio setting in .
Once the allowlist is set, it remains effective even if you leave and rejoin the channel.
If a user is included in both the allowlist and blocklist, only the blocklist takes effect.

section.p: You can call this method to specify the video streams of a user that you want to subscribe to.

ul.li: The allowlist is not affected by the setting in , and autoSubscribeAudio in .

plentry.pd: The list of user IDs whose video streams you want to subscribe to. To remove a user, call again with a new list that only includes the user IDs you still want to subscribe to.
The number of user IDs in the list.

List of user IDs whose video streams you want to subscribe to.
If you want to subscribe to a user's video stream, add their user ID to this list.
If you want to remove a user from the allowlist, call again with a new list that only includes the user IDs you still want to subscribe to.

pd.p: The user ID list of users that you want to subscribe to.

If you want to specify the video streams of a user for subscription, add the user ID of that user in this list. If you want to remove a user from the allowlist, you need to call the method to update the user ID list; this means you only add the uid of users that you want to subscribe to in the new user ID list.
